disease_label_per_paper: Immune thrombocytopenic purpura presenting with spontaneous gingival haemorrhage in pregnancy
presentation_summary: 28-year-old primigravida in the second month of pregnancy presented with spontaneous persistent gingival bleeding not precipitated by trauma.

On examination she had stable observations, no palpable lymphadenopathy, petechial rash over extremities and torso, no hepatosplenomegaly, profuse gingival bleeding, lower-lip hemorrhagic blisters, and oropharyngeal petechiae/ecchymosis.

Investigations showed isolated severe thrombocytopenia with platelets 2 x10^9/L, WCC 7.50 x10^9/L, hemoglobin 139 g/L, INR 1.0, APTT 30 s, PT 11 s, fibrinogen 200 mg/dL, CRP 2 mg/L, ALT 23 IU/L, and creatinine 110 umol/L.

risk_context.source_text_value: primigravida in her second month of pregnancy
She was not taking any medication.
There was no family history of clotting disorders.

observations.source_text_value: spontaneous and persistent gingival bleeding; profuse gingival bleeding observed at lower incisors and upper left quadrant
haemorrhagic blisters with spontaneous bleeding on her lower lip
petechial rash on her extremities and torso; oropharyngeal petechiae
mucocutaneous petechiae, ecchymosis and hemorrhagic blisters; oropharyngeal ecchymosis

confirmatory_findings.finding: Normal red and white cell morphology with no blasts
confirmatory_findings.source_text_value: Normal white blood cell and red blood cell morphology; no blasts or immature forms were observed.

confirmatory_findings.finding: Normal kidney and liver function tests
confirmatory_findings.source_text_value: Her kidney and liver function tests were within normal limits.

confirmatory_findings.finding: Autoimmune screen nonspecific and other thrombocytopenia causes excluded
confirmatory_findings.source_text_value: An autoimmune screen showed nonspecific enzyme reactive antibodies; all other causes of thrombocytopenia were excluded to confirm ITP in pregnancy.
Platelets responded from 2 to 41 x10^9/L at discharge after tranexamic acid, prednisolone, and IVIG.

actual_treatment: tranexamic acid mouth-rinse and intravenous tranexamic acid

outcome.source_text_value: Pregnancy remained uneventful and she delivered a healthy baby vaginally at 40 weeks; platelet count was 126 x10^9/L four weeks postpartum.

quality_warnings: Pregnancy is encoded as context/risk, not part of the disease name.
